situation (example wording): "How has police staffing changed in Chicago since 1980?", "number of officers per capita", "sworn officers in 1,000 in Salem"
what the app does today: Declined (the reader's change, count and rate words kept the question from being read as staffing).
proposed behavior: A neutral "changed" is the series by year, with no computed percent change unless asked. "The number of officers per capita" and "per population" are the rate, not a count asked beside a rate; "in 1,000" is per 1,000. A period left out is asked.
exact default or choices offered: By year; the rate per 100,000 unless another base is named.
why: The labels expect answers; people say "number of officers per capita" for the rate.
status: Decided 2026-11-11 (Jeff: "P101 - agreed"); "a period left out is asked" superseded by P181 (2026-11-21: every year by year)
test cases: Tests that ask its example question: scripts/test-nibrs-historical.ts.
